C0601.title: Supreme People's Court Typical Case: Wang and Others Used Virtual Currency to Transfer Telecom Fraud Proceeds
C0601.summary: On July 28, 2025, the Supreme People’s Court released typical cases on punishing crimes related to assistance for information network crimes. Case four was “Wang and others concealing or disguising criminal proceeds.” The SPC material states that Wang and others used virtual-currency transactions to conceal or disguise telecom-fraud proceeds for others, becoming accomplices that enabled telecom fraud to succeed; authorities treated the case as part of cutting off the fund-transfer chain that feeds such fraud. It was also presented as an example of full-chain enforcement against upstream and downstream cybercrime actors.
